name: Korean Realization Calculus (KRC) — Typed Discourse IR, Constraint-Preserving Realizer & Independent Evidence Critic
core_distinction: Not merely LLM prompt recipes and GAN-discriminator score. Explicit typed semantic/discourse representation mediates writer; separate critic inspects invariants and multi-dimensional contextual consequences.

Draft.trace: sentence/span to licensed fact atoms and discourse edges

stages.output: FactAtom graph+DiscourseEdge+InformationState; select ordering and permissible statements
stages.restriction: Does not write final Korean sentences or invent observations

stages.input: typed plan plus local language resources
stages.restriction: Do not change fact authority; LLM can suggest phrasings but does not certify facts

stages.input: immutable brief and finished draft; no generator self-rationale or generated scores
stages.restriction: Reject unsupported new assertions and false relations; lexical match alone is not semantic proof

stages.input: blinded finished prose and same brief
stages.output: contextual naturalness, coherence, authorial voice, genre suitability and reasons
stages.restriction: No optimizer updates from heldout judges

objective: Find Pareto-admissible realizations under inviolable semantic constraints and context-sensitive reader quality, not maximize one scalar adversarial discriminator.

formal_constraints.hard: Every asserted event must be licensed by F; invented observation, numeric/person fact or false causal entailment invalidates draft.
formal_constraints.discourse: Every explicit logical connective must have a warranted relation or be reported UNCERTAIN.
formal_constraints.reference: Ellipsis/pronouns require recoverable antecedents or a contextually deliberate ambiguity.
formal_constraints.soft: Sentence cadence, information order, lexical texture, paragraph structure, genre fit remain partially ordered; do not reduce to a blacklist.

training_design.GAN_analogy: G produces, V provides critical evidence, but V is not an uncalibrated real-vs-fake classifier.
training_design.anti_reward_hacking: Separate V hard factual claims from human taste; monitor grader exploitation; freeze blind reader samples; disallow repeated public test feedback.
training_design.control: Same model, facts, length and decoding; model/version frozen before actual formal benchmark. Do not equate assistant-authored demos with controlled models.
training_design.human_outcome: Pairwise reader judgments, ties permitted, plus independent fact audit; no detector-evasion goals.

minimal_prototype: Two authored briefs EX01 and EX04, three methodological demonstration texts each, annotated source trace, unscored evaluator contract.
